intro.text: A former seamstress and Windrunner squire to Sigzil.

items.text: During the Second Battle of Narak, Weiss went with Sigzil, Atakin, Leyten and one of Leyten's squires to investigate what proved to be a large army brought to the battle through Dai-Gonarthis's Elsegate. She briefly hoped it was only a Lightweaving made by the Masked Ones.
